The approach

We build safety first, then turn toward defense

Other programs send you straight to the hard stuff. We do things differently: strengthen your safety state, then, intentionally and within your capacity, turn toward defense. This is how real, sustainable change happens.

"…understanding what safety feels like for me" · an Academy member
"It has been a gradual process learning to recognize which state my nervous system is in and understanding what safety feels like for me. The live sessions have helped immensely in both understanding and applying the Polyvagal Theory material covered in the Unstucking Academy." An Academy member · name withheld at his request

What change looks like

What to realistically expect

Everything in the Unstucking Academy points at one thing: sustainable self-regulation. Can it reduce stuck defense? Yes. Is that guaranteed? Of course not. But here's what change can look like.

Pick what sounds most like you. Most people come in with more than one, and that's normal.

Where you're atWhere you're headed

If you live braced for the next bad thing (worried, on alert, hard to switch off): change tends to look like catching it sooner and coming back to calm faster, not the anxiety vanishing.

"When I was feeling anxious, I would just look around for anything that I felt connected to and focused on it, and it really worked and helped bring me back to the present moment."A member who worked on anxiety

Working doesn't mean the anger disappears. For people in our cohort the fight energy actually got more usable, less blowing up and more setting a boundary. (In the data, fight showed up less often but with more intensity, energy people could finally aim.)

"I was finally able to turn my fear into assertive, boundary-setting anger. A massive win."A member who worked on fight energy

This is the state people most often arrive in, and in the cohorts that tracked it week to week, it's also the one that eased the most. Change here usually looks like the shutdown feeling less solid, and a bit more stillness and energy that you actually chose.

"My confidence and capacity to sit with it has grown, leading to periods of real stillness and peace. I also feel more confident about what to do when something else, like anxiety, arises."A member who worked on shutdown

This is the smallest slice of our data, so here it's people's words more than numbers. Change looks like a little more room to move, and a little more say in what you do next.

"It gives skills to home in on the mobilization your body is actually asking for, what would feel good to do right now."A member who worked on mobilizing out of stillness

That's where you are and where you're headed with the Unstucking Academy. The real finish line is not needing the Academy at all. And that's how I've designed everything inside.

The numbers

Transparent data: real numbers from the Academy

Think about the progress you've made in the last four to eight weeks. Now look at what Academy students reported over that same stretch, tracking themselves week to week.

−29%

Defensive activation

The stuck, defensive states (shutdown, anxiety, anger, freeze): the median member shed about a third of theirs.

More on this

Combined defensive states, week one to final week, measured against each person's own starting level. This covers every cohort that tracked itself weekly (six runs of two programs, 2025 to 2026), counting each person's first cohort only. 25 of 35 people saw an overall drop.

+37%

Confidence

Of the confidence they had room to gain, the median member gained over a third.

More on this

Confidence in steadying yourself is scored 0 to 10, so someone starting at 8 can only gain 2. This number measures each person's gain against their own headroom. 21 of 35 rose, and 3 more started at the top with no room to move.

33 of 35

Improved somewhere

First-time participants who improved on at least one tracked front: defense, felt safety, or confidence.

More on this

Felt safety is the honest wobble in this data. People who started low tended to gain ground; people who started high often scored themselves lower later, partly because members get more discerning about what safety actually feels like.

These are honest numbers from 35 real people tracking themselves week to week, and they're what a student can realistically expect. Real change is gradual, uneven, and different for every nervous system. That's exactly what this data shows, and it's the only kind of progress I'll promise you.

Fit check

Is the Academy for you?

This isn't for everyone (and that's a good thing).

This is for you if…

  • You've been learning from the free content, and you're ready to practice, not just understand.
  • You want one sequenced path instead of another pile of coping techniques that lead nowhere.
  • You can show up in small, repeatable ways: a 10-minute lesson, a live practice, at whatever pace your capacity allows.
  • You don't want to do this alone anymore.

This isn't for you (yet) if…

  • You're in active crisis, or what you need right now is professional, individual care. The Academy works alongside these, never in place of.
  • You want content to passively consume. Everything here is built around practice.
  • You're looking for a quick fix. There isn't one here, just small, sustainable steps.
  • Paying for it would strain you this month. I have other options for you.

About Justin

But why me?

I'm Justin Sunseri, a therapist and self-regulation coach. Since 2019, I've been teaching you Polyvagal Theory and how to apply it through the Stuck Not Broken podcast. You've likely spent many hours with me, maybe even read my books, and you're ready to take things a step further.

The Academy is where all my knowledge and practices come together, refined through years of application and feedback.

FAQ

Questions

How does billing work?

Your membership renews automatically each month (you can review the options above). You'll get a receipt at every renewal, and you can cancel anytime in one click from your account. No cancellation fees, no guilt trips.

Can I switch tiers later?

Yes. Switch between Self-Regulator and Co-Regulator whenever you want, right from your account. There's no term to switch; billing is monthly, so you're never locked into a length.

What's your refund policy?

No refunds, and no pauses. Here's the honest why: Co-Regulator is capped at 100 seats. A refunded or paused seat is one someone else in need couldn't fill. This policy applies wherever you live, so please weigh it carefully and join only when you're sure. Not sure yet? Stay free for now, or email me first and we'll figure out your next step together.

How much time will I need each week?

The Academy is truly self-paced and designed to gradually increase your capacity. You choose based on what your capacity allows, whether live or through the curriculum.

Is community participation mandatory?

Yes and no. I want active, engaged members, but I won't force you to participate in any way that's uncomfortable for you. There are many ways to be part of the community, and I'm sure you'll find one. If you're not ready to connect with the community, you're probably better off in the Self-Regulator tier. Join Co-Regulator when you're ready.

What are the community guidelines?

It's a small group of global members from all demographics, and all members are at least 18. No one shares trauma stories (it's against the guidelines; if someone does, I remove the post and reach out privately), and there's no political or religious discussion.

How is this different than everything else?

The Academy is built on Polyvagal Theory and is free of psychobabble and woo-woo. It's hyper-focused and methodical: short lessons, brief practices, and sustainable growth without distracting detours into ego, shadow work, or parts work.

Another question? Let's talk.

If you're wondering whether the Academy is right for you, reach out to me, and I'll answer whatever questions you have.
